info.title: WiseMED AI
info.description: Clinical documentation assistant. No diagnosis, prescriptions or automatic HIS writes. Cookie auth for Vue; opaque bearer for Flutter. WSM JSON aliases under /api/wisemed-ai/v1 use explicitly mapped attested principals only. Full validated result snapshots are patch replacements, ordered by revision.

post.summary: Idempotent chunk upsert, ordered rebuild and validated full patch
post.description: Automatically send each stabilized transcript once. The server extracts only the new chunk and merges it into the existing report. Individual field failures return HTTP 200 with field_issues and needs_review data. Retry the identical chunk ID/revision only until acknowledged; duplicate acknowledgment performs no AI call. Previous chunks are retained internally for provenance, not re-extracted.

work_context.description: Optional work context, encrypted and included in idempotency validation.

target_field.description: Optional field key. Extraction and dictionary context are scoped to this field; other values remain unchanged.

Fact.description: Extracted observations carry a literal quote and chunk ID. Clinician edits have user_edited=true and no fabricated transcript evidence.

presentation.description: Selected authored wording per active section. Missing/ambiguous support retains base layout.

speech_terms.description: Versioned terminology, one expression per item; maximum 2048 UTF-8 bytes including separators per section. Shared by phone speech adaptation and OpenAI extraction/redaction, never clinical evidence.

generation_id.description: Optional owned generation receipt from templates/proposals; validated on publication. Use a newly accepted proposal receipt, not a receipt copied from another author.

ai_context.description: Optional authored context, encrypted in PostgreSQL and pinned to the published template version. Reference only; never patient evidence. Sent with AI extraction and counted in input usage.

accepted_section_text.description: Server replaces with text from the approved section; never an audio training target.

canonical_json.description: Exact UTF-8 payload covered by sha256. Validate before atomically replacing cache.

grammar.description: wisemed.speech-grammar-ir.v1; runtime_artifacts currently empty, no compatible decoder grammar.

speaker_key.description: Consistent pseudonym for the actual single speaker; no patient identifiers.
